title: Sleep Sufficiency Trends Among School-going Children and Adolescents
what_it_is: Sleep Sufficiency Trends Among School-going Children and Adolescents

sections.label: Student sleep sufficiency survey
sections.summary: MOE surveys Primary 5 and Secondary 3 students on sleep; in 2025 they averaged seven hours on school days, slightly up from 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) monitors sleep sufficiency by surveying Primary 5 and Secondary 3 students.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Based on the latest survey in 2025, Primary 5 and Secondary 3 students reported getting seven hours of sleep on average on school days, with a slight increase compared to 2023.

sections.label: Devices, parents, school start times
sections.summary: Secondary students' devices default to sleep mode at 10.30pm, MOE engages parents on sleep, and schools decide their own start times.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Starting from January this year, the personal learning devices for secondary school students have been set by default to go into sleep mode earlier at 10.30 pm.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE, in partnership with KK Women's and Children's Hospital, has engaged parents on practical ways to support students' sleep health through engagement sessions with medical experts on sleep matters.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE will continue to work with other Ministries and agencies through Grow Well SG to help our children inculcate healthy sleep habits.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: Certainly, in the context of sleep quantity, it is a proxy for the ability to sleep and maintaining a healthy sleep routine at home.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: We do not have data with regard to their sleep quality at this point of time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: On her question with regard to later school times, as mentioned in our Committee of Supply in 2026, earlier this year, in terms of school start times, schools are given the autonomy to decide on their start time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi
sentences.text: In determining school start times, schools do take into account specific context and trade-offs that arise with pushing back start times.
